headline: The TS pipeline is now defined by one dated regulatory event — ecopipam's FDA decision, due late Q1 2027 under Priority Review — with a cluster of PDE10A dopamine-modulators and non-invasive neuromodulation behind it, all set against a decade of repeated VMAT2 failures.

assets.name: Ecopipam
assets.ts_status: Lead indication — pediatric TS only; Priority Review + Orphan Drug + Fast Track
assets.next_milestone: FDA target action date: late Q1 2027 (NDA accepted Aug 19, 2026). Not yet approved.
assets.note: Teva agreed to acquire Emalex Apr 29, 2026, closed June 10, submitted the NDA June 18; FDA accepted it with Priority Review Aug 19, 2026. D1AMOND (JAMA Neurology): pediatric relapse HR 0.5, P=.008. New Oct 2026 MDS data: ~70% with clinically meaningful tic reduction within 8 weeks (post hoc); 45.6% mean tic-severity reduction at 18 months in the open-label extension, no new safety signals.

assets.name: Gemlapodect (NOE-105)
assets.next_milestone: Phase 2b ALLEVIA-2 (NOE-TTS-201) topline — OVERDUE. 12-wk, randomized, placebo-controlled, n=140, up to 15 mg QD; registry primary completion was estimated June 2026.
assets.note: Phase 2a (ALLEVIA-1, open-label): 7.8-point YGTSS-TTS reduction in 14 evaluable patients; met primary and key secondary endpoints. No Phase 2b topline had been located as of Nov 13, 2026 — the readout is the next competitive catalyst and its silence is itself worth watching.

assets.name: SCI-110 (THC + PEA/CannAmide)
assets.next_milestone: Phase 2b dosing/enrollment — crossover design with endpoints at weeks 12 and 26; target enrollment 164. Sites: Yale, Hannover Medical School, Tel Aviv Sourasky.
assets.note: Sites activated in 2026: Hannover (Jul 15), Yale (Aug 5); European drug-batch release reported Oct 2026 with all three sites initiated. Adults 18-65 only. Prior Phase 2a ~21% tic reduction (uncontrolled). Updates are company-sourced.

assets.name: Balipodect (TAK-063)
assets.phase: Phase 2 complete in schizophrenia; not yet in clinic for TS
assets.ts_status: Planned TS indication — no TS trial started
assets.next_milestone: Axsome guiding to Phase 3-enabling activities in schizophrenia in 2026; Tourette named as an additional target indication (no TS study registered)
assets.note: Acquired by Axsome from Takeda (announced April 1, 2026). Completed a 164-patient Phase 2 proof-of-concept in schizophrenia (2016); the 'TS secondary to schizophrenia' framing reflects that schizophrenia is the lead program. TS development stage is preclinical/planning as of the as_of date.

assets.name: EM-221 (formerly MR-1916)
assets.ts_status: Lead indication — TS and movement disorders
assets.next_milestone: Phase 2 TS trial (company has guided to Phase 2 initiation); Phase 1 MTD 15 mg, PDE10A PET occupancy up to 92.8%, ~24 h half-life
assets.note: Drug identity and Phase 1 data are from the peer-reviewed Cells (2024) report. Exact Phase 2 start/registration not independently confirmed live as of the as_of date; treat Phase 2 timing as company guidance, not a registered study.

assets.name: Neupulse
assets.sponsor: Neurotherapeutics Ltd / Neupulse (University of Nottingham spin-out)
assets.moa: Wrist-worn rhythmic 10-Hz median-nerve stimulation (non-invasive neuromodulation device)
assets.phase: Sham-controlled RCT complete; UK wellness device launched
assets.next_milestone: Medical-device version under regulatory development; no FDA clearance or US launch
assets.note: Launched as a UK 'wellness' wrist device (Neupulse C) in 2026 rather than a regulated medical device. Sham-controlled RCT (n=135) showed reduced tic frequency; see neupulse_rct.

assets.name: Deutetrabenazine (Austedo)
assets.phase: Phase 3 (ARTISTS 1 & 2) — negative; program discontinued for TS
assets.next_milestone: None for TS — ARTISTS 1 & 2 missed the primary YGTSS endpoint; marketed only for tardive dyskinesia and Huntington's chorea
assets.note: Included to document the VMAT2 class failures in TS (context for ecopipam's D1 approach).

assets.name: Valbenazine (Ingrezza)
assets.phase: Phase 2b (T-Force GOLD) — negative; TS program not pursued
assets.next_milestone: None for TS — T-Force GOLD (pediatric) missed the primary YGTSS endpoint (topline Dec 12, 2018); marketed for tardive dyskinesia and Huntington's chorea
assets.note: Second major VMAT2 failure in TS alongside deutetrabenazine's ARTISTS trials.
